title: Prepping for Color Thumbnails
content: (Link to video on Facebook)If you have a line drawing of a composition that you want to try out in color, here's what you can do:1. Scan it and print it at a small size.2. Glue it down with acrylic matte medium.3. Then you can paint multiple versions in water-based media.(Short vid on Facebook)New YouTube videoabout using gouache and watercolor for preliminary studies:
